title: 词典 Q
html:
词典 Q

概述

本页收录以字母 Q 开头的实用词汇，涵盖职场、日常和技术三大场景。每个词条给出词性、含义、常见搭配与例句，另设补充词汇、常用短语、易混淆词辨析与学习提示，便于按场景查阅与记忆。

职场与商务

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
qualify v. 使合格；有资格 qualify for You need three years of experience to qualify for the senior role.
quota n. 配额；定额 sales quota The sales team met their quarterly quota ahead of schedule.
quarterly adj./adv. 季度的；每季度 quarterly review We have a quarterly review to assess team performance.
quantify v. 量化 quantify the impact It's important to quantify the impact of our optimization efforts.
query n./v. 查询；疑问 raise a query If you have any queries, please contact the support team.
QA n. 质量保证 QA testing The QA team found three critical bugs before the release.
quit v. 辞职；退出 quit the job She decided to quit her job and start her own company.

日常与社交

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
quick adj. 快的；迅速的 quick question I have a quick question about the deployment process.
quirky adj. 古怪的；有趣的 quirky sense of humor His quirky sense of humor makes standups more enjoyable.
quest n. 追求；探索 quest for knowledge The quest for knowledge drives many people to learn new languages.
quarrel n./v. 争吵；口角 avoid quarrels Good communication helps avoid quarrels within the team.
quintessential adj. 典型的；精髓的 quintessential example This project is the quintessential example of agile done right.
quaint adj. 古朴的；别致的 quaint café We found a quaint café near the co-working space for lunch.
queue n./v. 队列；排队 wait in queue There's a long queue at the coffee shop every Monday morning.
quotation n. 引用；报价 request a quotation We sent a request for quotation to three different vendors.

技术相关

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
query n./v. 查询（数据库） SQL query Optimize the SQL query to reduce the response time.
queue n. 队列（数据结构） message queue The system uses a message queue to handle async tasks.
QPS n. 每秒查询数 handle high QPS The service needs to handle 10,000 QPS at peak traffic.
QuickSort n. 快速排序算法 implement QuickSort QuickSort has an average time complexity of O(n log n).
quorum n. 法定人数；仲裁数 quorum-based consensus The distributed system uses quorum-based consensus for data consistency.
QUIC n. 快速 UDP 互联网连接协议 QUIC protocol HTTP/3 is built on top of the QUIC protocol for faster connections.

补充词汇

词汇 词性 含义 常见搭配 例句
qualified adj. 合格的；有资质的 highly qualified We are looking for a highly qualified backend engineer.
questionable adj. 可疑的；有问题的 questionable decision Using a global variable here is a questionable decision.
quandary n. 困境；进退两难 in a quandary The team was in a quandary about which framework to choose.
quotient n. 商；系数 intelligence quotient The emotional quotient is as important as the intelligence quotient at work.
quasi adj. 准的；类似的 quasi-official The internal wiki serves as a quasi-official documentation source.

常用短语

短语 含义 例句
quick win 快速见效的成果 Let's focus on quick wins to build momentum for the project.
quality assurance 质量保证 Quality assurance is a critical part of our release process.
quite a few 相当多 Quite a few engineers attended the architecture review session.
question mark 疑问；不确定因素 There's still a question mark over the timeline for the migration.
quote unquote 所谓的 The "quote unquote" improvement actually made things worse.

易混淆词辨析

词组 区别说明
quiet vs. quite quiet 指"安静的"；quite 指"相当地"，拼写易混淆。
query vs. question query 更正式，常用于数据库和技术场景；question 更口语化。
quit vs. resign quit 较口语化，resign 更正式，用于书面场景。

学习提示

  • query 是技术场景中最常用的 Q 开头词汇，SQL query 是开发者的日常用语。
  • queue 既是日常英语中的"排队"，也是计算机科学中的基础数据结构。
  • QA 是软件行业的核心缩写，掌握 QA 流程对理解开发生命周期非常重要。
  • quick win 是敏捷开发和项目管理中的常用表达，指容易实现且效果显著的改进。
  • quorum 在分布式系统中是关键概念，与 Raft 和 Paxos 等共识算法密切相关。
  • quantify 在数据驱动的团队中是高频词，强调用数据说话的重要性。
  • quintessential 是高级形容词，在英文写作和演讲中使用它能显著提升表达水平。
  • QUIC 协议是 HTTP/3 的基础，了解它有助于理解现代网络性能优化。
  • quarterly 在企业管理中高频出现，季度报告（quarterly report）是商务沟通的重要内容。
  • quandary 比 dilemma 更书面，适合在正式场合描述面临的两难局面。
